name: Columbus AFB
description: Home of the 14th Flying Training Wing. Columbus AFB is a specialized undergraduate pilot training installation, training hundreds of pilots annually in the T-6 Texan II and T-38 Talon.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate (East Gate)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 access with visitor processing. Trusted Traveler program in effect 0600-2200.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 99)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Located at 108 Simler Blvd. Pre-registration available via email.
gates.address: 108 Simler Blvd, Bldg 99, Columbus AFB, MS 39710

resources.name: Dining Options (Crosswinds Club, Event Center, etc.)
resources.description: No traditional DFAC; dining available at Crosswinds Club, Event Center, Cactus Lanes Bowling, Coffee House, and other FSS locations.

resources.name: Columbus Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.

resources.name: Credit Union Branch
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: Fitness Center (Bldg 704)
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, Alpha Warrior Tent, and 24/7 access by request.

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for student pilots and permanent party.

resources.name: Magnolia Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. Front desk available for arrivals.

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.
resources.address: Bldg 1114, 166 C Circle, Columbus AFB, MS 39710

resources.name: 14th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining options, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation / FamCamp
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, Information Tickets & Travel, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Columbus Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: 14th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 99)
primaryAction.address: 108 Simler Blvd, Bldg 99, Columbus AFB, MS 39710

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Magnolia Inn (662-434-2548) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 14 FSS, M&FRC, and official Columbus sites for in-processing and pilot training support.
